theorems.label: Theorem 0.1
theorems.requirement: One retained original Birkhoff map, all integer orders m>=1, positive constants before the potential, both inequalities with exponents 2m and 4m-3 and only order-one and order-zero remainders.
theorems.qualification: Uses the original physical Birkhoff map identified with the accepted manuscript; constants depend on the integer order, not the potential.

theorems.label: Theorem 0.2
theorems.requirement: The same original renormalized Hamiltonian is real analytic and nonpositive on nonnegative summable actions, vanishes only at zero, extends near zero in ell2, and satisfies the quantitative real-Hessian concavity bound in every ell2 direction.
theorems.qualification: The same physical renormalized Hamiltonian is used throughout; concavity is local near zero, as stated.

theorems.label: Theorem 0.3
theorems.requirement: One frequency on the summable positive cone has all target exponents r>1; for every finite p>2 the same frequency extends analytically on ell(p/2), has an analytic inverse on neighborhoods of zero, and has the stated p/3 or ell(1+) correction.
theorems.qualification: Every finite p>2 is covered. The same frequency agrees on the nonnegative summable cone and has a local analytic inverse. No global injectivity or infinity source exponent is claimed.
